# Integration tests for the generated C++ target.
#
# `output/` is regenerated by ../build.sh (gitignored). The generated code is
# header-only, so this project compiles ONLY the hand-written tests in tests/
# and points the include path at output/ (the analog of the C# csproj default
# compile glob over output/**/*.cs and Java's srcDir("output")).
#
# One sequential binary: Catch2 runs TEST_CASEs in declaration order within a
# translation unit and does not parallelize, which is what the ordered live
# CRUD phases rely on (replaces the xUnit PriorityOrderer/fixture machinery).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(cpp_integration_tests CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

include(FetchContent)
FetchContent_Declare(
    Catch2
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/catchorg/Catch2.git
    GIT_TAG        v3.7.1
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(Catch2)

find_package(CURL REQUIRED)

file(GLOB TEST_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/*.cpp")
add_executable(cpp_tests ${TEST_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(cpp_tests PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/output")
target_link_libraries(cpp_tests PRIVATE Catch2::Catch2WithMain CURL::libcurl)

# ThreadSanitizer variant for the cache-concurrency suite (the C++ analog of
# Go's `-race` in test.sh): -DMYAIRTABLE_TSAN=ON adds a `cpp_tests_tsan` build.
option(MYAIRTABLE_TSAN "Build a ThreadSanitizer variant of the test binary" OFF)
if(MYAIRTABLE_TSAN)
    add_executable(cpp_tests_tsan ${TEST_SOURCES})
    target_include_directories(cpp_tests_tsan PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/output")
    target_link_libraries(cpp_tests_tsan PRIVATE Catch2::Catch2WithMain CURL::libcurl)
    target_compile_options(cpp_tests_tsan PRIVATE -fsanitize=thread -g)
    target_link_options(cpp_tests_tsan PRIVATE -fsanitize=thread)
endif()
